After hearing both sides, I am of the opinion that the writ petition need not be retained here.
The petitioner can be allowed to submit his objection to Ext.P6 within a time frame and there can be a direction to consider the same and conclude the proceedings initiated based on Ext.P6.

Therefore,
this Writ Petition is disposed of with the following manner:
1. The petitioner is free to submit his objection to Ext.P6 within one week from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.

2. Once such an objection is received, the 3 rd respondent will consider the same after giving an opportunity of hearing the petitioner as expeditiously as possible, at Sheril J vs State Of Kerala on 8 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/127405824/
